content: Edit Checkout Pages: Overview Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078267 Overview It's possible to edit various elements of the default checkout pages where website visitors sign up to join the website as a member or general user. The articles below explain different ways to edit checkout pages. Editing Checkout Pages How to Create Custom Checkout Forms How to Edit Titles, Text & Language How to Add, Edit and Remove Input Fields How to Display a Sidebar How to Add Custom SEO, CSS & JavaScript How To Edit Checkout URL For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
